'''Peter Purpura''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Levittown tournament (21 July)]] on 21 July 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|RalOps]], according to Wayne Cullen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2673">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-levittown-new-york-7-21-01d2673/ levittown-new-york-7-21-01], DeckTech (Wayne "Rebel Scum" Cullen, 21 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-levittown-new-york-7-21-01d2673/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
